exposure: Caesarean delivery before 26 weeks of gestation
Caesarean delivery between 26 and 34 weeks of gestation
cohort: 2270 mothers who delivered between 22 and 34 weeks of gestation in France
finding: Mothers who underwent caesarean delivery before 26 weeks of gestation had a significantly higher risk of experiencing severe depressive symptoms at neonatal discharge compared to those who delivered by caesarean section after 26 weeks.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery before 26 weeks gestation was associated with increased risk of maternal depression, but there was no association found between mode of delivery and anxiety.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was adjusted for in the analysis
